summary: Frontend visual verification for TRACK_ICON (DJ REHAB blue icon) rollout across Search, Favorites, Playlist detail track cards, and MiniPlayer. Search tab confirmed PASS: query 'love' returned 21 result cards, each rendering /assets/track-icon.png at 56x56px (naturalWidth=1024 -> asset loaded successfully). MiniPlayer confirmed PASS: after tapping a search result, playback started, MiniPlayer appeared with the icon at 40x40 (visible in screenshot). Regression: no red screens, no runtime errors, playback timer advanced (0:02 -> 0:09), navigation between tabs works. Favorites/Playlist-detail track rows could NOT be visually verified because the persisted state was empty (0 favorites, 0 playlists on this preview session) - the heart-button tap in MiniPlayer was not reliably clickable via DOM-based click due to Ionicons being font glyphs without testIDs, and no TEST_MyMix playlist existed from prior iterations (Library shows 'No playlists yet'). However, code inspection confirms identical <Image source={TRACK_ICON} .../> pattern is used in favorites.tsx (line 109) and playlist/[id].tsx (line 117) - same pattern that works on Search, so functionality is correct; only runtime data was missing.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package in use. Console warning: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages'. Reference: package usage in AudioPlayerContext files.

Heart favorite button in MiniPlayer has no testID. Ionicons render as font-glyphs on web without accessible name, making the favorite flow untestable via Playwright. Recommend adding testID='miniplayer-favorite-btn' to the heart TouchableOpacity in MiniPlayer.tsx (line ~130). Reference: /app/frontend/app/components/MiniPlayer.tsx:130

Many 'missing required default export' warnings for non-route files placed inside app/ directory (components/MiniPlayer.tsx, contexts/*, constants/*, utils/*). Expo Router treats every file in app/ as a route. Recommend moving these outside app/ (e.g., /app/frontend/components, /app/frontend/contexts) or configuring metro/expo-router to ignore them. Cosmetic warnings only, no functional impact.

action_items: PASS - No fixes required for the TRACK_ICON rollout. All 4 target files correctly import TRACK_ICON and render <Image source={TRACK_ICON}/>; the asset (/assets/track-icon.png, 68919 bytes, 1024x1024) loads successfully on web preview.
OPTIONAL: Add testID='miniplayer-favorite-btn' to the heart TouchableOpacity in MiniPlayer.tsx to enable automated favorite-flow testing in future iterations.
OPTIONAL: Migrate expo-av -> expo-audio for SDK 54 compatibility (this is pre-existing, not part of current change).
OPTIONAL: Relocate non-route files out of app/ directory to silence 'missing default export' warnings.
